{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing or sentinel values in customer_age
print("Unique values in customer_age:", sales_df['customer_age'].unique())
print("Count of -1 values (missing age):", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the mean age, excluding -1 (missing age)
mean_age = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
